headline: OpenAI reportedly weighs rebranding data centers as compute campuses
summary: OpenAI is reportedly considering rebranding its data centers as "AI compute campuses" amid growing public backlash over their electricity use, water consumption, pollution and effect on utility bills. One report ties the move to OpenAI's expectation that AI will become a major issue in the 2028 presidential election, prompting a policy and PR push after the midterms.
